notes.title: Pixeljam's Dino Run 2 Kickstarter Campaign
notes.content:
[p]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p]Utopia Must Fall is approaching a smaller but significant update in the next few weeks, be on the look out.  And now for the main reason to this post...[/p][p][/p][p]Pixeljam has always worked on multiple projects at once (with different teams), and the thing we've probably spent the most time on is a sequel to our 2008 browser game [b]Dino Run.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/5d81a15e7389bb67a1a0aad4d73cec0ae03f0fec.png"][/img][b]
[/b]It's pixel-art prehistoric multiplayer platformer with world-building tools included to let people create and share their own experiences.[/p][p]We've been either dreaming, planning, developing or crowdfunding on it since 2012 or so.  We finally have enough momentum to make a final push to get to Early Access release on Steam, and if you are curious about it, please check out the [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] that we just launched: [b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign?ref=9aoxr8"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign?ref=9aoxr8[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Everyone that backs it will get immediate access to the current Multiplayer Sandbox, where you can explore & experiment, design & destroy, hang out and have fun alone or with friends:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/3f1c7e23b2f891a3e5051580a3045158574ade27.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]
[/p]

notes.title: + The Industrial Update Is Live +
notes.content:
Hello all,

The time has come for the biggest update to Utopia Must Fall yet.  The [b]INDUSTRIAL UPDATE[/b] is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/cb96cb5fda57270189d174d4180e3de2b9e99d53.gif[/img]

[b]Featuring:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill tree: fully overhauled upgrade system with interactive tree structure, graphical icons for every upgrade and 4 special 'opportunity' slots. Requirements, blockers, hierarchy and time constraints for regular upgrades are demystified.
[*] Drones! Automated floating, modifiable allies that dodge hazards and chase enemies, equipped with onboard railgun turrets and adjustable behavioural parameters.
[*] Drone-related upgrades: Deploy Drone Factory, Twin Drone Factory, Atomic Drones, Double-Barrelled Drones, Robotics Specialist
[*] Watchtower mod: Q Disruptor - targets are temporarily timewarped to 0.25x regular speed
[*] Opportunity Upgrades: Cheap Nukes, Work Retreat, Red Flag Day, Context Switch
[*] New cities to defend: Cairo Horizon and HyperParis
[*] Many other additions, improvements, tweaks, balances, fixes, etc.
[/list]

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2849680/discussions/0/4634860082274833774/]Read the full changelog here.[/url][/b]

Let us know what you think in the comments and forums! Also, please leave a review for the game if you haven't yet, every little bit helps.

Finally, [b]we'll be increasing the price of the game in 2 weeks[/b], after the current discount ends.  Grab it now (or tell your friends about it) while it's still unreasonably inexpensive.

Thanks again for the support,

[i]- Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

Hello all,

Here is a preview of the battle drones, which will be available in week 1.  Build an enthusiastic little buddy to help fight for humanity right away, and steadily upgrade to a small army of automatic alien-slaughtering robo-beasts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/d3d021fb2faf9ff900dc12f41706a009497cfcb6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/3561c2dc6805f01a45375263428750ec4a29bc8b.gif[/img]

Also, if you haven't yet, please leave a review for the game!  Every little bit helps get the game out to new players, and we'd love to hear from you.

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: + Upcoming Plans / Price Increase / Developer Face Reveal +
notes.content:
Hello All,

On February 15th, we will be increasing the price of Utopia Must Fall to $6.99 USD.  We plan on upping it by a dollar for each major content update until it sits somewhere around 10 or 15 dollars total.  We look forward to having 10+ dollars worth of content for 1.0 release, whenever that may be.... probably some time in 2026.  

[b]Important:[/b]  when we do price increases, Steam auto-suggests prices in every other region, and we generally just set it to what it suggests.  But sometimes it suggests something that players in that region feel is way too high (often in Argentina, Turkey, Indonesia, etc).  If you notice the price of the game in your region rise to something that feels unbalanced with what the game offers, please contact us!  We're always open to reducing prices in other regions so that all may enjoy the game.

--------////+++++

Here is what we're thinking about working on next... not set in stone, but likely:

[list]
[*] New weapon upgrades to increase the early-game build variety
[*] Aerial battle drones (deploy and watch them fight for you)
[*] More cities to defend
[*] A free browser-based demo (with a slight spin on the game mechanics to keep it fresh)
[*] And of course the visualized skill tree
[/list]
++++++\\\\\\-------

And finally, since we were nominated for an IGF award recently, we had to make a video showing the lead developer (Datassette) talking about the game for one of their showreels.   Datassette is usually pretty camera-shy, but we managed to convince him to do it, and here is a peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/fecf6d2b3cbbf2fe4da3bf7a53e250e607cb4009.gif[/img]

Nice work, Datassette :)

Thanks again for the support,

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: + First Major Content Update '666' Is Live +
notes.content:
Greeting fellow UMFers,

We're pleased as porridge to announce that the first major content update for Utopia Must Fall is live.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2849680/discussions/0/4634860082274833774/]Read the full changelog here[/url].

Highlights:

[list]
[*] New upgrade: [b]Graphene Tipped Rods[/b], cobalt projectiles are slowed and become superheated on contact with nuke fireballs, passing through enemies and dealing damage multiple times (hot bullets)
[*] New upgrade: [b]Full Graphene Coating[/b] (hermit only), hot cobalt bullets melt through 50% more enemies
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/eec7142a676a75b5ff26ad5c8ccf0ff27d25a177.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Nullifiers now absorb a limited amount of nuke fireball energy before collapsing into a temporary wormhole releasing a swarm of [b]Anemones[/b]
[*] Anemones congregate above the city leeching shield energy. If the shield is offline, life force is drained directly from citizens
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/df5c1ae11ab54d852b0472411c0b4811a81c1f91.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] All unshielded enemies (except Nullifiers) can now be killed with nukes, those previously fully immune are now between 80% and 98% resistant
[*] All enemy shields are now destructible with bullets, lasers or flail strikes
[*] Cobalt Coil Gun deals 2x damage to enemy shields
[*] Two rare attack wave variants added (Mini Rebel Centipede, Contracting Nuclear Polygon Squad)
[/list]

There are also scads of balance adjustments, engine improvements, new sound effects, new music, and a few new achievements as well:

[list]
[*] [b]Gonnahavemesomefun[/b] - destroy a cloaking enemy before it had the chance to use its cloaking ability (enemies that enter already cloaked don’t count)
[*] [b]Hard Boiled[/b] - break an enemy shield using superheated projectiles
[*] [b]Seafood Platter[/b] - destroy an entire swarm of inter-dimensional Anemones
[*] [b]Blissful Ignorance[/b] - survive 14 days without taking any shield damage
[*] [b]Pretty Decent Innit?[/b] - suffer 3 shield breaks in one day
[*] [b]Bookworm[/b] & [b]Bohemian[/b] rewards / achievements brought back
[/list]

[b]BONUS BESTIARY[/b]

This will be in-game soon, but for now enjoy this handy guide to all that ails your precious city:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/7fbefaef65a7dfaf1c8d493f08bb6672462c0658.png[/img]

[b]WHAT'S NEXT?[/b]

New upgrades, new cities to defend, new enemies, and the ever-popular visualized skill tree:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/d31fc9e563f8b5bd4911c74ef9af9ec5d04024d9.png[/img]

[b]WANT TO HELP?[/b]

Please consider leaving a review if you have not already.  And for those that like to get more involved, [url=https://discord.gg/4qmxfKPQ]join our discord server[/url] (go to the umf channels).

Thanks again for the support, as well as the valiant effort to save humanity!

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: First Content Update Is Imminent, Help Us Last-Minute Test?
notes.content:
Hello all,

We're about to drop the first major content update for Utopia Must Fall.  Check it out on the BETA branch (Version 0.666) if you want a sneak peek before we make it live.  We've been testing extensively with a smaller group of people, and it's now ready to run the Steam Community gauntlet.  Here are the major changes, but a full changelog will be available soon:

Enemies:
- Nullifiers now absorb a limited amount of nuke fireball energy before collapsing into a temporary wormhole releasing a swarm of Anemones
- Anemones congregate above the city leeching shield energy. If the shield is offline, life force is drained directly from citizens
- Falling enemy gibs are now non-lethal to an unshielded city
- All unshielded enemies (except Nullifiers) can now be killed with nukes, those previously fully immune are now between 80% and 98% resistant
- Enemy shields are now destructible with bullets, lasers or flail strikes

Upgrades:
- Cobalt Coil Gun deals 2x damage to enemy shields
- Cobalt Coil Gun more likely to appear for Hermits
- New upgrade: Graphene Tipped Rods, cobalt projectiles are slowed and become superheated on contact with nuke fireballs, passing through enemies and dealing damage multiple times (hot bullets)
- New upgrade: Full Graphene Coating (hermit only), hot cobalt bullets melt through 50% more enemies
- Institute of Automation more likely to appear in the first week (Bookworm reward achievable again)
- Adaptive Beam Focusing removed, range vs damage outpost setting is now always available
- Shield capacity upgrades (hermit only) now give an instant recharge, are more generous, and display percentage values relative to initial maximum (numbers go above 100%)

Rewards / Achievements:
- Hard Boiled - break an enemy shield using superheated projectiles
- Seafood Platter - destroy an entire swarm of inter-dimensional anemones
- Blissful Ignorance - survive 14 days without taking any shield damage
- Pretty Decent Innit? - suffer 3 shield breaks in one day
- Bookworm & Bohemian rewards / achievements brought back

Other Improvements:
- Many nerfs and buffs, everywhere (we'll get more specific in final changelog)
- V-Sync timing mode now uses variable timesteps and allows framerates anywhere between 60-200hz (needs further testing, Delta timing is still the default for Windows installs)
- In-game FPS counter available via [c] key
- Fixed rare crash during shift-zoom transitions

Let us know what you think in the feedback channels on the forums, or in comments here.

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: + First Content Update Sneak Peek +
notes.content:
Hello UMFers,

We hope everyone has been enjoying the QoL update to the game, and now that we have that out of the way, it's time to focus on the good stuff - new content!

We're approaching 2025 with the perspective that more frequent but smaller updates is preferred over larger but less frequent ones.  So we're aiming to get the first one out next month...  it has a few new features, and here is a peek at one that you may appreciate - Cobalt Coil Gun is now armor-piercing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/249a52a09f1456d2fe11b6538f6118b52617b463.gif[/img]

We should start testing this (and some other new content) sometime in January, also aiming to release it in the same month if possible.  There is so much we want to add, but we're a small team (1 person on all aspects of development and 1 other on promo) so you know... it takes time to get it right.

One thing that really helps is leaving a review for the game.  So if you haven't done that, please do!  It does more good than you might realize :)

Have a great holiday break, and don't feel bad about letting Chicago 2.0 burn to the ground - they had it coming apparently.

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: + The Quality Of Life Update Is Live +
notes.content:
Hello all,

We're happy to announce that the first significant update to Utopia Must Fall is now live!

[i][b]Mac Users:  if the update doesn't launch properly, do a full uninstall and re-install.[/b][/i]

[h3][b]Version 0.656 - The QoL Update[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller support, offering customisable options for any combination of mouse, keyboard and gamepad, or fully gamepad controlled
[*] Full keyboard / d-pad access to all in-game interfaces
[*] Major performance improvements in line rendering (up to 60% faster)
[*] High frame rate support, up to 120fps
[*] Visual improvements: overhauled shaders, *Sharpie Mode*, extended display options including gamma adjustment
[*] Advanced BIOS options for fine tuning GPU settings - Press SHIFT on boot-up to activate (including skipping studio logos on boot, if you must)
[*] Multiple fixes for minor visual glitches and logic bugs
[*] Pause menu now available in upgrade / reward screens
[*] Wider aspect ratio and playfield
[*] Major internal engine refactor (groundwork for more updates!)
[*] Minimal nerfs / buffs to account for difficulty change associated with wider playfield
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2849680/discussions/0/4634860082274833774/]Read the full patch notes here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/5a8e10b332d4de88c64075d9f6ea68eb4316de0a.gif[/img]

Now, on to content updates!  Thanks again for the patience and support,

[i]- Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: + + Upcoming Updates // A New V99 Game In Steam Next Fest + +
notes.content:
Hello all, 

We've spent the last couple of weeks diving in to the very guts of the v99 engine hunting down bugs and making fundamental improvements. For us, this means we have a much nicer development workflow so we can bring you updates (and other v99 games) more quickly 🔧 , and for Utopia Must Fall, this means controller support, more efficient rendering, and significantly more stable frame rates 🎉 .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/79ff298c2c76e7b9d45daeb201a6595cb99e17b3.gif[/img]

We're aiming to release a small quality-of-life update in the next 2-3 weeks with all this, plus a few of the most-requested UI improvements. Once that's cleared out of the way, we can start building all the new feature ideas we have stacked up! (keep your suggestions coming).

And speaking of other V99 games, 3D 'shmuplike' GRID RANGER now has a 1-level demo that everyone can try right now, as part of the Steam Next Fest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/909f137ef13fcc9adf27946e1040cdf4d5d1a360.gif[/img]

Check out the game here:  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2964400/Grid_Ranger/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2964400/Grid_Ranger/[/url]

Thanks for the patience and support!

-[i]Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: + POST-LAUNCH REPORT / FUTURE PLANS +
notes.content:
Hello all,

Now that the dust has settled from launch, we can have a big exhale and figure out what's next for Utopia Must Fall.  A lot of great suggestions and feedback so far...

A lot of you have echoed what we already planned to do: more variety in the early game, and more ways to kick ass in the late game.  Those things are top priority, but we'd also like to add controller & deck support, new enemies, etc.  We'll figure out the right order of things in time.

The lead dev (Datassette) also [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2849680/discussions/0/4760956432761723157/][b]posted a message on the forums[/b][/url] that is worth checking out!

if you didn't read it, the main takeaway is that he crunched like mad to get the game launched and needs a little decompression time.  He'll be back on the updates soon enough though.  In the meantime I'll be engaging with players and helping to figure out what's priority for the next round of updates.

Here is our roadmap so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013932/4f9a66d8ef9f7d278217554884410192f0439bdc.gif[/img]

We expect this to change over time as new ideas emerge and players continue to give their thoughts.

In summary, we are grateful for the support so far and we're glad people are enjoying it... this is only the beginning!

Take care,

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]
